title: Bubble Drift
theme: A tiny robot drone tends a crystal garden path, placing containment-bubble turrets to gently trap crawling crystal pests before they reach the heart crystal, collecting amber to build and upgrade defenses across ten waves.
mechanics: Place bubble turrets on empty tiles beside the crawler path
Turrets automatically trap nearby crawlers in containment bubbles
Trapped crawlers release amber used to build and upgrade turrets
Stop crawlers from reaching the heart crystal across ten waves
Upgrade turret range and firing speed with amber

controls.action: Place or select a bubble turret
controls.key: Click or tap an empty grid tile beside t
Click or tap the Upgrade button
Click or tap the Start Wave button
